code: import{useState}from"react";import{initialProjects}from"./mockData";const KEY="nexus_merged_projects_v1";export default function useProjects(){const[projects,setProjectsState]=useState(()=>{try{const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY));return Array.isArray(saved)?saved:initialProjects;}catch(error){return initialProjects;}});function setProjects(next){setProjectsState(previous=>{const value=typeof next==="function"?next(previous):next;localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(value));return value;});}function resetProjects(){localStorage.removeItem(KEY);setProjectsState(initialProjects);}return{projects,setProjects,resetProjects};}
